name: How much does a kitchen addition cost in the Denver area?

mainEntity.name: How much does a kitchen addition cost in the Denver area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Costs vary widely based on square footage, structural work, finishes, plumbing, electrical, and how much of the existing kitchen must be reworked. Denver-area kitchen expansions are often substantial projects, and larger additions can run much higher than a simple remodel. A detailed line-item estimate is the best way to compare value and avoid surprise costs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen addition costs depend on size, structure, utilities, and finish level, so there is no single price. A line-item estimate is the best way to understand your real budget.
